label: BIRP
description: Behavior / Intervention / Response / Plan — standard for group therapy, residential treatment, and substance-use disorder programs. Emphasizes the therapeutic process over diagnosis.

fields.label: Presenting Behavior
fields.ai_hint: What the client did and said during the session.

fields.label: Mood/Affect
fields.ai_hint: Client's self-reported mood and observed affective tone.

fields.label: Reported Symptoms
fields.ai_hint: Discrete symptoms the client reported in this session.

fields.label: Interventions Used
fields.ai_hint: Therapeutic techniques the clinician applied during the session.

fields.label: Rationale
fields.ai_hint: Why these interventions were chosen for this client at this time.

fields.label: Client Response
fields.ai_hint: How the client responded to the interventions used.

fields.label: Engagement Level
fields.ai_hint: Observed engagement during the session (resistant, ambivalent, engaged, etc.).

fields.label: Progress Observed
fields.ai_hint: Within-session shifts the clinician noted in the client's presentation.

fields.label: Homework Assignments
fields.ai_hint: Tasks or practices assigned to the client between sessions.

fields.label: Next Steps
fields.ai_hint: Planned clinical focus for upcoming sessions.

fields.label: Next Session
fields.ai_hint: Scheduled date/time or cadence for the next appointment.

label: DAP
description: Data / Assessment / Plan — the most common SOAP alternative for individual therapy. Collapses the Subjective/Objective split into a single Data section.

fields.label: Presenting Concern
fields.ai_hint: The primary issue the client raised in this session.

fields.label: Mood/Affect
fields.ai_hint: Client's self-reported mood and observed affective tone.

fields.label: Symptoms
fields.ai_hint: Discrete symptoms the client reported in this session.

fields.label: Session Content
fields.ai_hint: A concise narrative of what the client discussed in session.

fields.label: Observations
fields.ai_hint: Clinician-observed presentation, behavior, and speech.

fields.label: Clinical Impression
fields.ai_hint: Clinician's overall impression of the client's current state.

fields.label: Progress
fields.ai_hint: Movement relative to treatment goals since the last session.

fields.label: Risk Assessment
fields.ai_hint: Any observed or reported risk to self or others.

fields.label: Interventions Used
fields.ai_hint: Therapeutic interventions applied during this session.

fields.label: Homework Assignments
fields.ai_hint: Tasks or practices assigned to the client between sessions.

fields.label: Next Steps
fields.ai_hint: Planned clinical focus for upcoming sessions.

fields.label: Next Session
fields.ai_hint: Scheduled date/time or cadence for the next appointment.

label: GIRP
description: Goal / Intervention / Response / Plan — outcome-driven format common where insurers require goal and outcome tracking aligned to a treatment plan.

fields.label: Session Goal
fields.ai_hint: The specific goal or focus area being worked on this session.

fields.label: Treatment Plan Objective
fields.ai_hint: The overarching objective from the treatment plan this session targets.

fields.label: Interventions Used
fields.ai_hint: Therapeutic techniques the clinician applied this session.

fields.label: Rationale
fields.ai_hint: Why these interventions match the stated goal.

fields.label: Client Response
fields.ai_hint: How the client responded to the interventions used.

fields.label: Progress Toward Goal
fields.ai_hint: Observed movement toward the session goal.

fields.label: Measurable Outcome
fields.ai_hint: Observable change during or after the session.

fields.label: Homework Assignments
fields.ai_hint: Tasks aligned to the session goal, assigned between sessions.

fields.label: Next Steps
fields.ai_hint: Planned focus for the next session.

fields.label: Goal Status
fields.ai_hint: Status of the session goal: achieved, partial, no progress, or modified.

label: Intake
description: First-session biopsychosocial assessment, billed as CPT 90791. Patient-context document supporting medical necessity for the course of treatment. Required by CMS MBPM Ch. 15 §160, Joint Commission EC/PC standards, and CARF 1.H. before ongoing therapy is reimbursable.

fields.label: Referral Reason
fields.ai_hint: Why the patient was referred or sought care, in their own words where possible. Usually surfaces in the opening minutes of the session.

fields.label: Chief Complaint
fields.ai_hint: The primary problem that brought the patient in today. Use the patient's own words in quotes when they're clear.

fields.label: History of Present Illness
fields.ai_hint: Onset, duration, severity, triggers, course, and prior episodes of the chief complaint as the patient describes them.

fields.label: Psychiatric History
fields.ai_hint: Prior mental-health diagnoses, treatments, hospitalizations, and medications as the patient reports them. Leave empty if not discussed.

fields.label: Medical History
fields.ai_hint: Relevant medical conditions, surgeries, and chronic illnesses the patient mentions. Leave empty if not discussed.

fields.label: Current Medications
fields.ai_hint: Each medication the patient reports, with dose and prescriber when stated. One item per medication.

fields.label: Substance Use History
fields.ai_hint: Alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, and other substance use as the patient describes it. Populate only when explicitly discussed.

fields.label: Family History
fields.ai_hint: Family history of mental-health or substance-use conditions as the patient reports it. Populate only when explicitly discussed.

fields.label: Developmental History
fields.ai_hint: Developmental milestones, early childhood, and educational history the patient describes. Populate only when discussed.

fields.label: Trauma History
fields.ai_hint: Traumatic experiences the patient discloses. Use the patient's own framing; do not infer trauma from absence. Often deferred from intake.

fields.label: Social History
fields.ai_hint: Housing, employment, education, finances, legal involvement, military service, and cultural or spiritual identity as discussed.

fields.label: Relationships & Supports
fields.ai_hint: Family system, partners, friends, and other support network as the patient describes them.

fields.label: Speech
fields.ai_hint: Audible features only: rate, rhythm, volume, fluency. Do not infer; report what is heard.

fields.label: Mood & Affect
fields.ai_hint: Self-reported mood in quotes where possible; affect inferred from prosody and content (e.g. congruent, blunted, labile).

fields.label: Thought Process & Content
fields.ai_hint: Linear vs. tangential is audible. Suicidal or homicidal ideation, delusions, or obsessions only when the patient explicitly reports them.

fields.label: Perception
fields.ai_hint: Hallucinations, derealization, or depersonalization only when the patient explicitly reports them.

fields.label: Strengths
fields.ai_hint: Personal strengths, resources, and protective qualities the patient names or demonstrates. One item per strength.

fields.label: Initial Recommendations
fields.ai_hint: Recommended level of care, modality, frequency, and any referrals as discussed in session.

label: Medications
description: The client's current and past medications.

fields.label: Drug
fields.ai_hint: Medication names, current and past.

fields.label: Dose
fields.ai_hint: Dosage for each medication.

fields.label: Route
fields.ai_hint: Route of administration for each medication.

fields.label: Frequency
fields.ai_hint: How often each medication is taken.

fields.label: Prescriber
fields.ai_hint: Prescribing clinician for each medication.

fields.label: Start/Stop Dates
fields.ai_hint: Start date, and stop date if discontinued, for each medication.

fields.label: Notes
fields.ai_hint: Additional notes on efficacy, side effects, or adherence.

label: Meeting Summary
description: Professional minutes for a recorded business meeting — attendees, discussion, decisions, and action items. For calls that are not clinical sessions, e.g. vendors, referral partners, or consultants.

fields.label: Attendees
fields.ai_hint: People present in the meeting, with role or affiliation when stated in the transcript. Never invent names.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.ai_hint: Why the meeting happened — the stated objective or agenda, in one or two sentences.

fields.label: Summary
fields.ai_hint: A concise narrative of the discussion: the main topics, each party's position, and how the conversation concluded.

fields.label: Key Points
fields.ai_hint: The most important takeaways from the discussion.

fields.label: Decisions
fields.ai_hint: Decisions actually made in the meeting, each with who made or agreed to it. Exclude options merely discussed.

fields.label: Action Items
fields.ai_hint: Concrete commitments, each with its owner and due date when the transcript states them.

fields.label: Open Questions
fields.ai_hint: Questions raised but not resolved, or topics explicitly deferred to a later conversation.

fields.label: Next Meeting
fields.ai_hint: Agreed date, time, or cadence for the next touchpoint, if one was discussed.

label: Narrative
description: A single free-form narrative note for sessions that do not fit a structured format.

fields.label: Note
fields.ai_hint: A clinically-appropriate narrative summary of the session.

label: Psychiatric initial evaluation
description: First visit with a new client: a psychiatric diagnostic evaluation or a new-patient E/M visit, with a psychotherapy section for visits that include therapy.

fields.label: Visit details
fields.ai_hint: One line each: date of service; visit start and end time exactly as the clinician stated them; the visit code as entered, and any code (with a psychotherapy add-on code) exactly as the clinician stated it. "Not stated." for any the clinician did not say. Leave psychotherapy times and minutes out: the Psychotherapy section states them.

fields.label: Place of service
fields.ai_hint: If the place of service is telehealth, write: "Visit conducted by synchronous audio and video telehealth on a HIPAA-compliant platform. The client was in <client location> ("at home in <client location>" when the client said they were at home); the provider was in <provider location>. The client consented to receive care by telehealth." using the entered locations (write "location not entered" for a missing one). If in office, write "In-office visit." If not provided, write "Not stated."

fields.label: Chief complaint
fields.ai_hint: One or two sentences, ideally a short quotation of the client's own words about why they came.

fields.label: Current symptoms
fields.ai_hint: Each current symptom the client described, in the client's terms where possible.

fields.label: Onset, duration and frequency
fields.ai_hint: For each symptom: when it began, how long it has lasted, how often it happens and in what settings, as reported.

fields.label: Modifying factors
fields.ai_hint: What makes the symptoms better or worse, as reported.

fields.label: Severity and functional impact
fields.ai_hint: How severe the symptoms are and how they affect work, school, relationships and daily life, with the client's concrete examples.

fields.label: Context
fields.ai_hint: The circumstances around the symptoms: stressors, life events and timing, as reported.

fields.label: Earlier episodes and diagnoses
fields.ai_hint: Earlier episodes of the same symptoms and any diagnoses given before, as reported.

fields.label: Depression
fields.ai_hint: What the clinician asked about depressed mood, interest, energy and guilt and the client's answers: pertinent positives and negatives, denials recorded as denials. "Not asked." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Mania or hypomania
fields.ai_hint: What the clinician asked about elevated mood, decreased need for sleep, racing thoughts and impulsive spending or risk-taking and the client's answers: pertinent positives and negatives, denials recorded as denials. "Not asked." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Anxiety
fields.ai_hint: What the clinician asked about worry, panic and avoidance and the client's answers: pertinent positives and negatives, denials recorded as denials. "Not asked." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Obsessions and compulsions
fields.ai_hint: What the clinician asked about obsessions and compulsions and the client's answers: pertinent positives and negatives, denials recorded as denials. "Not asked." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Trauma responses
fields.ai_hint: What the clinician asked about nightmares, flashbacks, avoidance and hypervigilance and the client's answers: pertinent positives and negatives, denials recorded as denials. "Not asked." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Psychosis
fields.ai_hint: What the clinician asked about hallucinations, paranoia and unusual beliefs and the client's answers: pertinent positives and negatives, denials recorded as denials. "Not asked." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Attention
fields.ai_hint: What the clinician asked about attention, distractibility and hyperactivity and the client's answers: pertinent positives and negatives, denials recorded as denials. "Not asked." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Sleep
fields.ai_hint: What the clinician asked about sleep onset, maintenance and total hours and the client's answers: pertinent positives and negatives, denials recorded as denials. "Not asked." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Eating
fields.ai_hint: What the clinician asked about appetite, weight change, restriction, bingeing and purging and the client's answers: pertinent positives and negatives, denials recorded as denials. "Not asked." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Alcohol
fields.ai_hint: Alcohol: current and past use, age at first use, amount and frequency, periods of sobriety or treatment, tolerance or withdrawal, as reported. Record a denial as a denial. "Not asked." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Cannabis
fields.ai_hint: Cannabis: current and past use, age at first use, amount and frequency, periods of sobriety or treatment, tolerance or withdrawal, as reported. Record a denial as a denial. "Not asked." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Stimulants
fields.ai_hint: Stimulants not prescribed to the client, including methamphetamine: current and past use, age at first use, amount and frequency, periods of sobriety or treatment, tolerance or withdrawal, as reported. Record a denial as a denial. "Not asked." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Cocaine
fields.ai_hint: Cocaine: current and past use, age at first use, amount and frequency, periods of sobriety or treatment, tolerance or withdrawal, as reported. Record a denial as a denial. "Not asked." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Opioids
fields.ai_hint: Opioids, prescribed or not: current and past use, age at first use, amount and frequency, periods of sobriety or treatment, tolerance or withdrawal, as reported. Record a denial as a denial. "Not asked." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Benzodiazepines
fields.ai_hint: Benzodiazepines and other sedatives, prescribed or not: current and past use, age at first use, amount and frequency, periods of sobriety or treatment, tolerance or withdrawal, as reported. Record a denial as a denial. "Not asked." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Tobacco / nicotine
fields.ai_hint: Tobacco, vaping or other nicotine: current and past use, age at first use, amount and frequency, periods of sobriety or treatment, tolerance or withdrawal, as reported. Record a denial as a denial. "Not asked." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Other substances
fields.ai_hint: Any other substance: current and past use, age at first use, amount and frequency, periods of sobriety or treatment, tolerance or withdrawal, as reported. Record a denial as a denial. "Not asked." if it did not come up. A catch-all question ("anything else?", "any other drugs?") counts as asking: record the answer to it.

fields.label: Earlier diagnoses
fields.ai_hint: Psychiatric diagnoses given before, with when and by whom, as reported.

fields.label: Psychotherapy
fields.ai_hint: Past and current psychotherapy: type, when, and how it went, as reported.

fields.label: Psychiatric medications tried
fields.ai_hint: Each psychiatric medication tried before: name, dose, how long, effect and side effects, as reported. One per item.

fields.label: Hospitalizations and programs
fields.ai_hint: Psychiatric hospitalizations, partial hospitalization and day programs, with when and why, as reported. Record a denial as a denial.

fields.label: Past suicide attempts, self-harm or harm to others
fields.ai_hint: Quote what was said about past suicide attempts, self-harm or harm to others, and what followed. Record a denial as a denial. Do not assess.

fields.label: Legal or custody involvement
fields.ai_hint: Legal or custody involvement as reported, or the denial. "Not asked." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Trauma history
fields.ai_hint: Whether the client reported a history of trauma and in what period of life, without detail the client did not give. Record a denial as a denial.

fields.label: Living situation
fields.ai_hint: Where and with whom the client lives.

fields.label: Relationships
fields.ai_hint: Partner, family and friendships, as reported.

fields.label: Work or school
fields.ai_hint: Occupation or schooling and how it is going.

fields.label: Supports
fields.ai_hint: Who supports the client, as named.

fields.label: Cultural considerations
fields.ai_hint: Cultural, religious, language or identity considerations relevant to care, as the client or clinician described them. "Not asked." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Medical history
fields.ai_hint: Medical conditions, surgeries and medical hospitalizations as reported. If the client reported none, write that these were asked about and denied.

fields.label: Psychiatric
fields.ai_hint: Psychiatric conditions and suicide in the family, with the relative, as reported.

fields.label: Medical
fields.ai_hint: Medical conditions in the family, as reported.

fields.label: Medications that helped relatives
fields.ai_hint: Medications that helped a relative with a psychiatric condition, as reported.

fields.label: Current medications
fields.ai_hint: From the chart, exactly as given, or 'None recorded'. Then each medication the client reports currently taking that the chart lacks, with the dose as stated, appended as (stated this visit: "..."). A medication started, stopped or changed in this visit goes in the plan, not here.

fields.label: Allergies
fields.ai_hint: From the chart, exactly as given (a list, NKDA, or 'Not recorded'). Then any allergy, or denial of allergies, the client or clinician states in this visit, appended as (stated this visit: "..."). Never write NKDA unless the chart says it.

fields.label: Outside providers
fields.ai_hint: Other clinicians involved in the client's care (by role, e.g. primary care, therapist), as named.

fields.label: Coordination
fields.ai_hint: Coordination agreed or done with those providers, including releases of information, as stated.

fields.label: Appearance and behavior
fields.ai_hint: As observed or dictated by the clinician (grooming, eye contact, psychomotor activity).

fields.label: Orientation
fields.ai_hint: As stated by the clinician (e.g. alert and oriented x4).

fields.label: Speech
fields.ai_hint: Rate, rhythm, volume and tone, as stated by the clinician.

fields.label: Mood and affect
fields.ai_hint: Mood in the client's words where available; affect as the clinician described it.

fields.label: Thought process
fields.ai_hint: As described by the clinician (e.g. linear, goal-directed, tangential).

fields.label: Thought content and perception
fields.ai_hint: Hallucinations, delusions, preoccupations, and suicidal or homicidal thoughts as stated, from the clinician.

fields.label: Cognition
fields.ai_hint: Attention, memory and concentration as stated by the clinician.

fields.label: Insight and judgment
fields.ai_hint: As stated by the clinician.

fields.label: Suicidal / homicidal ideation
fields.ai_hint: What was said about current suicidal or homicidal thoughts, intent, plan or means: the exact words, verbatim, in quotation marks, from the visit or the clinician's dictated addendum, naming who said them. Never a paraphrase, never a summary, never a level the clinician did not say. "Not stated." if nothing was said.

fields.label: Risk and protective factors
fields.ai_hint: Risk factors and protective factors as the clinician or client named them: the exact words, verbatim, in quotation marks, from the visit or the clinician's dictated addendum, naming who said them. Never a paraphrase, never a summary, never a level the clinician did not say. "Not stated." if none were named.

fields.label: Overall risk
fields.ai_hint: Only the clinician's own stated judgment of overall risk, verbatim, in quotation marks (e.g. "overall risk is low"). Never a paraphrase, never a level the clinician did not say. "Not stated." if the clinician did not state one.

fields.label: Safety plan
fields.ai_hint: Only if any ideation, self-harm or high risk was reported: the safety planning the clinician described (warning signs, coping, supports, crisis contacts, making the environment safer), in the clinician's own words, verbatim, in quotation marks; never a paraphrase or summary. Otherwise leave empty.

fields.label: Measures completed
fields.ai_hint: Screening instruments mentioned in the visit (e.g. PHQ-9, GAD-7) with the score and when completed in the words used; never convert a weekday or relative time into a calendar date. Leave empty if none were mentioned.

fields.label: Diagnoses
fields.ai_hint: Each diagnosis the clinician stated, with its code exactly as the clinician said it and its status (working, provisional, rule out) only when the clinician said so. Never add a diagnosis or a code.

fields.label: Diagnostic rationale
fields.ai_hint: For each diagnosis, the clinician's own rationale tying the history and examination to the diagnostic criteria, with severity and functional impairment, as the clinician expressed it. Do not form a judgment the clinician did not express.

fields.label: Problems addressed
fields.ai_hint: One sentence: the conditions addressed at this visit and the status of each as the clinician described it (e.g. "ADHD, stable on the current dose; anxiety, worse over the last two weeks"). State facts; do not name a level.

fields.label: Data reviewed
fields.ai_hint: One sentence: what was reviewed or ordered (measures, labs, outside records, the PDMP report, history from someone other than the client). "None" if nothing was. Do not name a level.

fields.label: Management
fields.ai_hint: One sentence: what the management involved, factually (e.g. prescription drug management with which medications were continued, changed, started or stopped; a controlled substance; a decision about a higher level of care). Do not name a level.

fields.label: Plan
fields.ai_hint: Each thing started or recommended (medication, therapy, other services) with the clinician's stated reason. Record only decisions the clinician stated; never suggest one.

fields.label: Off-label justification
fields.ai_hint: The clinician's stated justification for any off-label choice. Leave empty if none.

fields.label: Informed consent
fields.ai_hint: For each medication started or recommended: which elements the clinician said were covered (risks, benefits, side effects, alternatives, pregnancy-related risk where relevant) and the client's agreement. Only what was said.

fields.label: Prescriptions
fields.ai_hint: Each prescription written: medication, dose, frequency and quantity, as the clinician stated them. One per item.

fields.label: PDMP
fields.ai_hint: If the clinician said the state prescription monitoring program (PDMP) was checked, write "State prescription monitoring program (PDMP) reviewed on <date>: <finding as stated>." where <date> is the calendar date the clinician gave, or the date of service when the clinician said "today" or gave no date (never the word "today"). If a controlled substance was prescribed and the clinician did not mention the check, write "Not stated." If no controlled substance was involved and no check was mentioned, leave empty.

fields.label: Labs
fields.ai_hint: Labs and home measurements (such as blood pressure readings) ordered, requested from another clinician or the client, or reviewed, with the values as stated. Leave empty if none.

fields.label: Return visit
fields.ai_hint: When the client returns, as the clinician stated it.

fields.label: Between visits and emergencies
fields.ai_hint: What the clinician told the client to do between visits, for side effects or in an emergency (e.g. call the office, 988, 911, nearest emergency room), as stated.

fields.label: Psychotherapy time
fields.ai_hint: Start time, end time and minutes of the psychotherapy portion, exactly as the clinician stated them, and only the ones they stated (e.g. "18 minutes"). Never compute or estimate from the transcript timestamps. "Not stated." if the clinician stated none of them.

fields.label: Modality and interventions
fields.ai_hint: The approach and interventions as the transcript shows them. Name a technique only when the clinician named it or did its steps (weighing evidence for and against a thought is Socratic questioning). Where the clinician listened, reflected or asked open questions and named nothing, say that in plain words, with no technique name (not "supportive therapy").

fields.label: Response
fields.ai_hint: What the client said or did in response, the client's words quoted as theirs. A rating or count only as the client gave it.

fields.label: Goal and plan
fields.ai_hint: The goal as the clinician or client stated it, and any assignment agreed for before the next visit. Never write a goal nobody stated: if only an assignment was given, write only the assignment. "Not stated." if neither was said.

label: Psychiatric follow-up (E/M + psychotherapy)
description: Medication-management follow-up, with a psychotherapy section for visits that include therapy.

fields.label: Visit details
fields.ai_hint: One line each: date of service; E/M code and psychotherapy add-on code exactly as the clinician stated them. "Not stated." for any the clinician did not say. Leave psychotherapy times and minutes out: the Psychotherapy section states them.

fields.label: Place of service
fields.ai_hint: If the place of service is telehealth, write: "Visit conducted by synchronous audio and video telehealth on a HIPAA-compliant platform. The client was in <client location> ("at home in <client location>" when the client said they were at home); the provider was in <provider location>. The client consented to receive care by telehealth." using the entered locations (write "location not entered" for a missing one). If in office, write "In-office visit." If not provided, write "Not stated."

fields.label: Chief complaint
fields.ai_hint: One or two sentences, ideally a short quotation of the client's own words about why they are here today.

fields.label: Depression
fields.ai_hint: What changed since the last visit in depressed mood, interest, energy, guilt and hopelessness: pertinent positives and negatives as stated, denials recorded as denials. "Not discussed." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Anxiety
fields.ai_hint: What changed since the last visit in worry, panic and avoidance: pertinent positives and negatives as stated, denials recorded as denials. "Not discussed." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Insomnia and sleep
fields.ai_hint: What changed since the last visit in falling asleep, staying asleep, hours slept and daytime tiredness: pertinent positives and negatives as stated, denials recorded as denials. "Not discussed." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Inattention and hyperactivity
fields.ai_hint: What changed since the last visit in focus, distractibility, finishing tasks and restlessness: pertinent positives and negatives as stated, denials recorded as denials. "Not discussed." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Mania
fields.ai_hint: What changed since the last visit in elevated or irritable mood, less need for sleep, racing thoughts and impulsive spending or risk-taking: pertinent positives and negatives as stated, denials recorded as denials. "Not discussed." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Appetite and eating
fields.ai_hint: What changed since the last visit in appetite, weight, restriction, bingeing and purging: pertinent positives and negatives as stated, denials recorded as denials. "Not discussed." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Onset, duration and course
fields.ai_hint: When the current symptoms or this change began, how long it has lasted, and its course since the last visit (better, worse, unchanged), as stated. "Not discussed." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Recent stressors
fields.ai_hint: Stressors and life events since the last visit, as stated. "Not discussed." if none came up.

fields.label: Functioning
fields.ai_hint: What changed since the last visit at work or school, in relationships and in daily activities, with the client's concrete examples. "Not discussed." if it did not come up.

fields.label: Medication adherence
fields.ai_hint: Whether the client is taking medications as prescribed, missed doses, and reasons, as reported.

fields.label: Side effects
fields.ai_hint: Side effects the client was asked about and the answers, by name (e.g. sleep, appetite, palpitations, sexual side effects). Record denials as denials.

fields.label: Alcohol
fields.ai_hint: The chart's substance use baseline for alcohol, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then this visit's screen: "(asked this visit: no change)", (stated this visit: "...") with the change as stated, or "(not asked this visit)".

fields.label: Cannabis
fields.ai_hint: The chart's substance use baseline for cannabis, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then this visit's screen: "(asked this visit: no change)", (stated this visit: "...") with the change as stated, or "(not asked this visit)".

fields.label: Stimulants
fields.ai_hint: The chart's substance use baseline for stimulants not prescribed to the client, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then this visit's screen: "(asked this visit: no change)", (stated this visit: "...") with the change as stated, or "(not asked this visit)".

fields.label: Cocaine
fields.ai_hint: The chart's substance use baseline for cocaine, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then this visit's screen: "(asked this visit: no change)", (stated this visit: "...") with the change as stated, or "(not asked this visit)".

fields.label: Opioids
fields.ai_hint: The chart's substance use baseline for opioids, prescribed or not, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then this visit's screen: "(asked this visit: no change)", (stated this visit: "...") with the change as stated, or "(not asked this visit)".

fields.label: Benzodiazepines
fields.ai_hint: The chart's substance use baseline for benzodiazepines or other sedatives, prescribed or not, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then this visit's screen: "(asked this visit: no change)", (stated this visit: "...") with the change as stated, or "(not asked this visit)".

fields.label: Tobacco / nicotine
fields.ai_hint: The chart's substance use baseline for tobacco, vaping or other nicotine, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then this visit's screen: "(asked this visit: no change)", (stated this visit: "...") with the change as stated, or "(not asked this visit)".

fields.label: Other substances
fields.ai_hint: The chart's substance use baseline for any other substance, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then this visit's screen: "(asked this visit: no change)", (stated this visit: "...") with the change as stated, or "(not asked this visit)". A catch-all question ("anything else?", "any other drugs?") counts as asking: record the answer to it.

fields.label: Current medications
fields.ai_hint: From the chart, exactly as given, or 'None recorded'. Then each medication the client reports currently taking that the chart lacks, with the dose as stated, appended as (stated this visit: "..."). A medication started, stopped or changed in this visit goes in the plan, not here.

fields.label: Allergies

fields.ai_hint: From the chart, exactly as given, or 'Not recorded'. Then anything the client or clinician states in this visit that changes or adds to it, appended as (stated this visit: "...").

fields.label: Suicidal / homicidal ideation
fields.ai_hint: What was said about suicidal or homicidal thoughts, intent, plan or means: the exact words, verbatim, in quotation marks, from the visit or the clinician's dictated addendum, naming who said them. Never a paraphrase, never a summary, never a level the clinician did not say. "Not stated." if nothing was said.

fields.label: Self-harm / violent behavior
fields.ai_hint: What was said about self-harm or violence: the exact words, verbatim, in quotation marks, from the visit or the clinician's dictated addendum, naming who said them. Never a paraphrase, never a summary, never a level the clinician did not say. "Not stated." if nothing was said.

fields.label: Risk and protective factors
fields.ai_hint: Risk factors and protective factors as the clinician or client named them: the exact words, verbatim, in quotation marks, from the visit or the clinician's dictated addendum, naming who said them. Never a paraphrase, never a summary, never a level the clinician did not say. "Not stated." if none were named.

fields.label: Overall acute risk
fields.ai_hint: Only the clinician's own stated judgment of overall acute risk, verbatim, in quotation marks (e.g. "overall risk is low"). Never a paraphrase, never a level the clinician did not say. "Not stated." if the clinician did not state one.

fields.label: Safety plan
fields.ai_hint: Only if any ideation, self-harm or violence was reported: the safety planning the clinician described (warning signs, coping, supports, crisis contacts, means safety), in the clinician's own words, verbatim, in quotation marks; never a paraphrase or summary. Otherwise leave empty.

fields.label: Appearance and behavior
fields.ai_hint: As observed or dictated by the clinician (grooming, eye contact, psychomotor activity).

fields.label: Orientation
fields.ai_hint: As stated by the clinician (e.g. alert and oriented x4).

fields.label: Speech
fields.ai_hint: Rate, rhythm, volume and tone, as stated by the clinician.

fields.label: Mood and affect
fields.ai_hint: Mood in the client's words where available; affect as the clinician described it.

fields.label: Thought process
fields.ai_hint: As described by the clinician (e.g. linear, goal-directed, tangential).

fields.label: Thought content and perception
fields.ai_hint: Hallucinations, delusions, preoccupations, and SI/HI as stated, from the clinician.

fields.label: Cognition
fields.ai_hint: Attention, memory and concentration as stated by the clinician.

fields.label: Insight and judgment
fields.ai_hint: As stated by the clinician.

fields.label: Measures reviewed
fields.ai_hint: Instruments mentioned in the visit (e.g. PHQ-9, GAD-7) with the score, any prior score, and when it was completed in the words used (e.g. "on Friday"); never convert a weekday or relative time into a calendar date. Leave empty if none were mentioned.

fields.label: Diagnoses
fields.ai_hint: The chart's active problems, each with its code exactly as listed. Add a diagnosis the clinician named in the visit that is not on the list, with the status "stated this visit" and a code only when the clinician gave one. If the list is empty and none was named, leave this empty.

fields.label: Clinical formulation
fields.ai_hint: The clinician's own synthesis of how today's history and observations relate to each diagnosis, including severity, course (stable, improving, worsening) and functional impact, as the clinician expressed it. Do not form a judgment the clinician did not express.

fields.label: Medical necessity
fields.ai_hint: One sentence on why continued treatment is needed, drawn from what the clinician said about the condition and plan.

fields.label: Problems addressed
fields.ai_hint: One sentence: the conditions addressed at this visit and the status of each as the clinician described it (e.g. "ADHD, stable on the current dose; anxiety, worse over the last two weeks"). State facts; do not name a level.

fields.label: Data reviewed
fields.ai_hint: One sentence: what was reviewed or ordered (measures, labs, outside records, the PDMP report, history from someone other than the client). "None" if nothing was. Do not name a level.

fields.label: Management
fields.ai_hint: One sentence: what the management involved, factually (e.g. prescription drug management with which medications were continued, changed, started or stopped; a controlled substance; a decision about a higher level of care). Do not name a level.

fields.label: Medications
fields.ai_hint: For each medication: continue, change, start or stop, with dose and frequency, and the clinician's stated reason. For a medication continued at the same dose, the reason the clinician gave for continuing it (e.g. stable, still improving, side effects tolerable). Record only decisions the clinician stated; never suggest one.

fields.label: PDMP
fields.ai_hint: If the clinician said the state prescription monitoring program (PDMP) was checked, write "State prescription monitoring program (PDMP) reviewed on <date>: <finding as stated>." where <date> is the calendar date the clinician gave, or the date of service when the clinician said "today" or gave no date (never the word "today"). If a controlled substance was prescribed or continued and the clinician did not mention the check, write "Not stated." If no controlled substance was involved, leave empty.

fields.label: Informed consent
fields.ai_hint: For any medication started, changed or continued where consent was discussed: which medication, and which elements the clinician said were covered (benefits, risks and side effects, alternatives, risk of misuse or dependence for controlled substances), and the client's agreement. Only what was said.

fields.label: Education
fields.ai_hint: Each thing the clinician taught or explained about a medication, a diagnosis or a risk (what a medication does, its side effects, how long it takes to work), as stated. One per item. Leave empty if the clinician explained nothing.

fields.label: Lifestyle counseling
fields.ai_hint: Each piece of advice the clinician gave about behavior, sleep, diet, exercise or substance use, as stated. One per item. Leave empty if the clinician gave none.

fields.label: Labs
fields.ai_hint: Labs and home measurements (such as blood pressure readings) ordered, requested from another provider or the client, or reviewed, with the values as stated. Leave empty if none.

fields.label: Referrals and coordination
fields.ai_hint: Referrals made and coordination with other providers, as stated. Leave empty if none.

fields.label: Follow-up
fields.ai_hint: Return interval as the clinician stated it.

fields.label: Emergency instructions
fields.ai_hint: Instructions the clinician gave for side effects or emergencies (e.g. call the office, 988, 911, nearest emergency room), as stated.

fields.label: Psychotherapy time
fields.ai_hint: Start time, end time and minutes of the psychotherapy portion, exactly as the clinician stated them, and only the ones they stated (e.g. "18 minutes"). Never compute or estimate from the transcript timestamps. "Not stated." if the clinician stated none of them.

fields.label: Issues addressed
fields.ai_hint: The behaviors, symptoms or problems worked on during the therapy portion.

fields.label: Modality and interventions
fields.ai_hint: The approach and interventions as the transcript shows them. Name a technique only when the clinician named it or did its steps (weighing evidence for and against a thought is Socratic questioning). Where the clinician listened, reflected or asked open questions and named nothing, say that in plain words, with no technique name (not "supportive therapy").

fields.label: Response
fields.ai_hint: What the client said or did in response, the client's words quoted as theirs. A rating or count only as the client gave it.

fields.label: Goal and plan
fields.ai_hint: The goal as the clinician or client stated it, and any assignment agreed for before the next visit. Never write a goal nobody stated: if only an assignment was given, write only the assignment. "Not stated." if neither was said.

fields.label: Progress toward goal
fields.ai_hint: What the client reported doing on an earlier goal or assignment, and any rating that changed this visit, with the numbers as given. No judgment of it ("meaningful", "demonstrated", "improved"). "Not stated." if nothing was reported.

fields.label: Therapy plan and cadence
fields.ai_hint: How often therapy continues, only as the clinician said it (e.g. "at each visit"). When the next visit is booked is not a therapy plan. "Not stated." if the clinician said nothing about it.

label: Psychotherapy note
description: Your own notes on a session, kept apart from the progress note.

label: Safety Plan
description: Stanley-Brown Safety Planning Intervention (Stanley & Brown 2012). Endorsed by VA/DoD CPG, SAMHSA, Zero Suicide Institute, and Joint Commission NPSG 15.01.01. Six strict steps — surveyors check the Step 3 (distractions) vs. Step 4 (help-seeking) distinction, and require means-restriction to be specific, not the word 'discussed.' Replaces the contraindicated 'no-suicide contract' (Rudd et al. 2006); do not add one. Transcript-mode rule applies: the LLM only populates a step's field when the recording explicitly supports it — warning signs and coping strategies must come from the patient, never invented from absence.

fields.label: Warning Signs
fields.ai_hint: Personal warning signs the patient identifies — thoughts, images, mood states, situations, or behaviors that signal a developing crisis. Use the patient's own language. One item per sign. Populate only when the patient names them.

fields.label: Internal Coping Strategies
fields.ai_hint: Things the patient can do alone — without contacting another person — to take their mind off the crisis (e.g. exercise, music, prayer, a specific routine). One strategy per item. Populate only what the patient names.

fields.label: People & Settings for Distraction
fields.ai_hint: People or social settings the patient can use as a distraction from suicidal thoughts. NOT for help-seeking — that is Step 4. Do not include phone numbers here; names of people or places only. Populate only what the patient names.

sections.label: Step 4 — People to Ask for Help

fields.label: People to Ask for Help
fields.ai_hint: People the patient will contact for help during a crisis — distinct from Step 3 distractions. Each item should capture the person's name and phone number as the patient gives them. Populate only what the patient names.

fields.label: Professional & Agency Contacts
fields.ai_hint: Clinicians, urgent-care lines, and crisis services the patient will contact. Each item should capture name, role, and phone number. The 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline must be present; add it if the patient did not name it.

fields.label: Firearms Restriction Plan
fields.ai_hint: The specific plan for restricting access to firearms — who will store them, where, by when. Surveyors reject the word 'discussed'; the plan must be concrete. Populate only what the patient and clinician agreed to in the recording.

fields.label: Medications Restriction Plan
fields.ai_hint: The specific plan for securing medications — lockbox, supply limits, who holds the key. Concrete, not 'discussed.' Populate only what was explicitly agreed.

fields.label: Other Means Restriction Plan
fields.ai_hint: Any other lethal means addressed (sharps, ligatures, vehicles, location access) and the specific restriction plan. Populate only what was explicitly discussed.

fields.label: Reasons for Living
fields.ai_hint: Patient-named reasons for living (Linehan adjunct used by many SPI programs). One reason per item, in the patient's own framing. Populate only what the patient names.

label: SOAP
description: Subjective / Objective / Assessment / Plan — the default clinical format used for individual therapy sessions.

fields.label: Chief Complaint
fields.ai_hint: The primary reason the client stated for attending this session.

fields.label: Mood/Affect
fields.ai_hint: Client's self-reported mood and observed affective tone.

fields.label: Symptoms
fields.ai_hint: Discrete symptoms the client reported in this session.

fields.label: Client Narrative
fields.ai_hint: A concise narrative of what the client discussed.

fields.label: Appearance
fields.ai_hint: Observed physical presentation of the client.

fields.label: Behavior
fields.ai_hint: Observed behavioral patterns during the session.

fields.label: Speech
fields.ai_hint: Rate, rhythm, volume, and coherence of speech.

fields.label: Thought Process
fields.ai_hint: Organization and logic of the client's thinking.

fields.label: Affect Observed
fields.ai_hint: Clinician-observed affective presentation.

fields.label: Clinical Impression
fields.ai_hint: Clinician's overall impression of the client's current state.

fields.label: Progress
fields.ai_hint: Movement relative to treatment goals since the last session.

fields.label: Risk Assessment
fields.ai_hint: Any observed or reported risk to self or others.

fields.label: Functioning Level
fields.ai_hint: Client's current functional status.

fields.label: Interventions Used
fields.ai_hint: Therapeutic interventions applied during this session.

fields.label: Homework Assignments
fields.ai_hint: Tasks or practices assigned to the client between sessions.

fields.label: Next Steps
fields.ai_hint: Planned clinical focus for upcoming sessions.

fields.label: Next Session
fields.ai_hint: Scheduled date/time or cadence for the next appointment.

label: Treatment Plan
description: Written treatment plan, signed by clinician — required by CMS (42 CFR 410.43), state Medicaid plans, CARF 1.J., Joint Commission PC.01.03.01, and all major MCOs for continued authorization. Not separately billable, but a missing or stale plan voids reimbursement for the underlying therapy sessions. Drafted by cross-note synthesis from the patient's intake and recent session notes — not from a live transcript — then reviewed and signed between sessions. Goals must be measurable; objectives must be SMART and link back to a goal; interventions must link back to an objective; review_due_date is the single most common audit failure.

fields.label: Problem List
fields.ai_hint: Draft the patient's clinical problems from the intake note's presenting concern, history of present illness, and DSM-5 impressions. One concise problem per item, in clinical language the clinician will refine. Do not invent problems not supported by the source notes.

fields.label: Strengths & Supports
fields.ai_hint: Draft from the intake's strengths section and any supports the patient described (relationships, employment, recovery capital). One item per strength or support; mirror the patient's framing where it is in the source notes.

fields.label: Long-Term Goals
fields.ai_hint: Draft long-term goals from intake themes plus recent session progress. One goal per item; prefer the patient's own words where they appear in the source notes. Goals are aspirational outcomes — the clinician will decompose them into SMART objectives separately, so do not pre-write objectives here.
